lines.en: My hook hand hangs at my side.
I should run, but this foot won't move.
My eyepatch covers one eye.
The floor is old and creaks.
My tail drags a line behind me.
I lean toward the hallway's end.

lines.zh: 这身破旧的海盗服还在。
lines.en: My ragged pirate outfit remains.
I lean on the wall, unable to advance.

lines.zh: 舞台的木板上有一道缝。
lines.en: A crack runs in the stage boards.
My toes point at the door.
Dust has covered my boots.
I tilt my head as if listening.
I hold my hook, silent.
One side of my jaw hangs loose.

lines.zh: 布条从我的袖口垂下来。
lines.en: Rags hang from my cuff.
A pirate flag behind me.
I wait for a door to open.
My eyes are two amber points.
A chunk is missing from my heel.
I smell of seawater.
Quiet enough to hear the wiring.
My mouth is open, as if laughing.
An insect crawls from a floor crack.
I count the ceiling lights.
My hook catches a bit of light.

lines.zh: 我的眼罩下，那只眼亮着。
lines.en: Under my eyepatch, one eye glows.
You're standing in the hallway.
This eye of mine sees you clearly.
Your flashlight found my hook.
You're more nervous than most.
I'd like to walk, but I don't move.
The door behind you is shut.
I heard you swallow.
You look left, so do I.
I've held this pose for years.
Your footsteps echo too much.
I'm here, always here.

lines.zh: 你手心的汗把电筒弄滑了。
lines.en: Sweat is making your torch slip.
Your shadow is stretched long.
Do I frighten you like this?
Step farther and I'll watch less.
Pirates never turn their backs to the door.

lines.zh: 你退到走廊尽头，没路了吧。
lines.en: You have backed to the corridor's end; nowhere left.
You still haven't left.
My cloth has torn.
A new gash in my shell.
No pain, only noise.
My eyepatch slipped halfway.
Wires show through the seam.
My hook is bent.

lines.zh: 这身破衣服又破了一处。
lines.en: Another tear in these ragged clothes.
I'm still in place.
You've provoked the wrong thing.
Let's wait for the repairman.
I can't bite anything.
For me? Set it on the tray.

lines.zh: 塑料牙咬下去只会打滑。
lines.en: Plastic teeth would only slip on that.
Pirates don't eat that.

lines.zh: 我伸出钩子，又收了回去。
lines.en: I reach out my hook, then pull it back.
I can't smell it, no need to hide it.
Keep it, the night is long.

lines.zh: 这味道属于活人的世界。
lines.en: That belongs to the living world.

lines.zh: 拿走吧，我连头都低不了。
lines.en: Take it, I can't even lower my head.
You really think you can buy me.
Your shoulder hits my hook.

lines.zh: 我晃了晃，钩子还在原位。
lines.en: I sway, the hook stays put.
Don't touch my eyepatch.
You knocked a rag off my cuff.
This board under me is giving way.
You didn't budge my frame.
Your hand brushed my hook's point.
Back off, the hook is sharp.
Your shoulder is as hard as mine.
Crowd more and we both fall.
I'm a fixture of this diner.
Say that to the living.
I don't have that kind of motor.
My hook would hurt you.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，做不了什么。
lines.en: I can't move, I can't do anything.
This outfit is a costume.
Find someone else, child.
A pirate loves only his ship.
I've never left this stage.
Such words come far too late.
The hook can hold it, my hand can't.
I see it, by your boot.
I can't bend down myself.
This iron is badly rusted.
Give it to someone else.

lines.zh: 你脚边那枚硬币，拿起来。
lines.en: That coin by your foot, pick it up.

lines.zh: 我记着这店里的每样东西。
lines.en: I know everything in this diner.
No one comes to collect these.
It'll lie there forever.
Don't shove it under my feet.
I can only stand and watch.
I've fixed on this eye of yours.
A pirate's patience is deep as the sea.
The door shut behind you.
You've taken a long hallway.
This hallway ends with me.
I won't chase, no need to run.
You hold a lamp, I hold a hook.
Don't think standing makes me useless.

lines.zh: 你听见我的布料在响吗？
lines.en: Do you hear my cloth rustle?
Count to three and you'll look back.
I've been here many years.

lines.zh: 你的房间就在走廊那头。
lines.en: Your room is at the far end.
I don't need to chase you.
Sooner or later you'll come before me.
I can wait.
This eye of mine never blinks.
My hook mirrors your torchlight.
There's an echo deep in the hall.
This old suit of mine is worn.
You walk with a hand on the wall.

lines.zh: 我看得见你手上的钥匙。
lines.en: I see the keys in your hand.

lines.zh: 这块地板的裂缝会绊你。
lines.en: That floor crack will trip you.
Two more flickers and the light dies.
You're counting your own heartbeats.
And I'm listening.
You dare not look back at me.
And yet I'm always here.
Your torch is trembling.

lines.zh: 这店里只有你一个活人。
lines.en: You're the only living one in the diner.
And one standing behind you.

lines.zh: 我从幕布缝里看着你，一眨不眨。
lines.en: I watch you through the curtain gap, never blinking.
You, however, are sweating.
Dawn is near.

lines.zh: 我的钩子只是晃了一下。
lines.en: My hook merely swayed.

lines.zh: 你被自己的脚步绊倒了。
lines.en: You tripped on your own step.
I didn't strike you.
My hook's tip caught you.
I stayed rigid; you're the one who flinched.
Your blood drips on the floor.
Faint, but it can be heard.
Don't run into my hook.

lines.zh: 我前倾着，全靠支架撑住。
lines.en: I lean forward, held up by my rig.
You've backed into a dead corner.
My cloth sleeve brushed you.
A pirate doesn't swing at air.
That cut on your hand is deep.
I didn't move at all.
Yet you're bleeding.
My hook tip tears open your cuff.

lines.zh: 幕布拉开，我站在海盗旗旁。
lines.en: The curtain opens, I stand by the pirate flag.

lines.zh: 海盗旗下面，我又站好了。
lines.en: Under the pirate flag I am set upright again.

lines.zh: 我的钩子撞了一下门框。
lines.en: My hook struck the doorframe.
Dust gathers where I stand.
My eyepatch sits slightly askew.

lines.zh: 舞台角落还有我的位置。
lines.en: There's still my spot in the stage corner.
I hold a forward-leaning pose.
The light comes down from above.
Only one of my eyes is lit.
I know this hallway.
Someone set me here.
The set changed, I didn't.
My old damage is still on my shell.
Someone is closing a door behind.
I hear the sound of the sea.
There are no ships here.
Still, I take my place.
A pirate never misses the show.
The cloth catches fire at once.

lines.zh: 倒下时钩子刮响了地板。
lines.en: Falling, my hook screeches on the floor.
Water fills my shell and I sink.

lines.zh: 我的半个身子飞了出去。
lines.en: Half of me is blown away.

lines.zh: 这东西卡在我的眼罩上。
lines.en: That stuck in my eyepatch.

lines.zh: 我的电机乱响，灯也乱了。
lines.en: My motor races, my lights go wild.
Without power, even standing is hard.

lines.zh: 雷落下，我整个人弹了一下。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my whole frame jolts.

lines.zh: 虚空里，我的钩子也没处挂。
lines.en: In the void my hook has nothing to catch.
